cash_tip: Good news if you're low on pesos: Norange takes debit and credit cards plus Apple Pay and Google Pay through Mercado Pago, and JAHGYRO GYROS accepts cards for delivery. When you do need cash, use a bank ATM instead of a standalone one, always pick 'decline conversion' so you're charged in pesos, take out a bigger amount once, and keep small bills handy for tacos, taxis and the market.
